item.title: E-Z-GO to support competitors in inaugural Optum Golf Channel Games
item.description: Textron E-Z-GO LLC, a Textron company, will provide E-Z-GO vehicles to support competitors in the inaugural Optum Golf Channel Games, which will air live at 7 p.m. EST on Dec. 17 on Golf Channel and USA Network. item.title: Bowdon stops Lincoln County three yards short to claim 4th straight state championship
item.description: Lincoln County came within two yards of a state championship, but Bowdon held on in the final seconds to secure a 35–31 victory in a thriller that featured big plays, controversial moments, and a frantic finish. The post Bowdon stops Lincoln County three yards short to claim 4th straight state championship appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Greenbrier girls flag football completes three-peat with 20–13 win over Jenkins
item.description: The Greenbrier High School girls flag football team secured its third consecutive state championship with a 20–13 victory over Jenkins High School. The post Greenbrier girls flag football completes three-peat with 20–13 win over Jenkins appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Data center proposed by Byrd Farms among latest applications for Columbia County’s D-C zoning
item.description: A more than 900-acre campus that includes the Byrd Farms property, less than two miles from the entrance of White Oak Park, is yet another project that has emerged to go before Columbia County in the wake of the recent establishment of the county’s Data Center (D-C) district. item.title: Man found dead near Circle K in Aiken County; Investigation underway
item.description: The Aiken County Sheriff’s Office is investigating the shooting death of a man found near the parking lot of a Circle K convenience store, authorities said. The post Man found dead near Circle K in Aiken County; Investigation underway appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta approves no-tax-increase budget using one-time funds, deep cuts
item.description: Reconvening for a third time Tuesday, the Augusta Commission approved a balanced 2026 budget without a property tax increase, relying instead on one-time funding transfers and deep cuts to city departments and non-government organizations. The post Augusta approves no-tax-increase budget using one-time funds, deep cuts appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta man dies after moped crash during sheriff’s office pursuit
item.description: A 53-year-old Augusta man died Tuesday after the moped he was driving crashed into a vacant building on Gordon Highway while being pursued by the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office, according to the Coroner’s Office. The post Augusta man dies after moped crash during sheriff’s office pursuit appeared first on The Augusta Press.
